setup: C2: ungated LLM supervisor sets composition setpoints over linear-MPC backend (16-OP grid)
C1_note: Pareto-swept linear MPC x100 ref and TL-tuned PID by pre-registered shootout (p.4-5)
C2_note: P95 IAE ratios with bootstrap CIs, per-scenario IAE (p.10, Table 1)
C3_note: 16 off-nominal OPs, F +/-20% and zF +/-10% feed steps (p.8)
C4_note: N=10 seeds/cell, bootstrap CIs; models, T, top_p, provider pinned; prompt text in repo only (p.5-6, p.8)

C6_note: Only rule-based Critic bounds check; no counts of Critic rejections reported (p.5)
llm_latency: median 15.3 s, IQR 11.3-21.0, max 278 s per cycle (Fig.5 p.14)

setup: C3: LLM supervisor plus forked-twin counterfactual safety gate over MPC backend
C1_note: vs C2 ungated, with C1 MPC (~0.38 IAE) and C0/C1 nominal refs (p.11, p.14)
C2_note: Canonical IAE medians, P95, Cohen d, peak deviation, block counts (p.11-15)
C3_note: 4 OPs x feed steps F +/-20%, zF +/-10% (p.10)
C4_note: 10 seeds per cell, 250 cells, bootstrap CIs; model and sampling pinned (p.10)
C5_note: 590 blocks of 1839 gated proposals: 318 effective, 221 no-op, 51 run-fatal (p.14-15)
C6_note: Gate challenged by real bad proposals: follower tails blocked, but onset false negatives (cs04) (p.7-8, p.11)
llm_latency: median 18.6 s, IQR 15.2-23.3, max 63 s per cycle (Fig.5 p.14)
key_result: Gate cuts attractor-OP median IAE 6.401 to 0.486 (P95 11.46 to 0.774, d=-1.44) but makes control-2 OP 50/50 run-fatal (p.11-12)
limitation: Gate contains but does not recover; zero-margin spec renders OP inoperable; intercept rate degenerate by construction (p.8, p.15, p.19)
